counter_profile: Canonical PDFMalExtract v0.1 / RIT feature contract, reused without silent semantic changes
byte_features: Literal byte occurrences with the released overlap rules; not parser-confirmed active-action reachability
constant_exclusion_meaning: Train zero variance in the declared counter profile; does not establish absence of all real PDF AcroForm, color or encoding structures
ObfuscationCount: Actual raw PDF name-like tokens containing a valid #HH escape; each escaped token counted once; no encoded-stream inflation or malicious-intent claim
script_ratio: (JS + JavaScript) / (1 + obj), using those declared raw counters

missing_model_policy: Native NaN boosting; RF/FT train-fold median plus ten fixed metadata flags; complete Markov input and finite generated probabilities need no imputation
static_security_boundary: No rendering, embedded payload/action/URL execution or dynamic sandbox execution
